lines.arrive: A locked room. Cards come in through a slot in the wall, covered in marks you can't read.
lines.ask: There's a rulebook. You don't need to understand the marks. Only to match them, and post the answer out.
lines.book: A huge rulebook. For every card that comes in, it shows you which card to send back.
lines.sent: You post it back. Outside, someone reads it.
lines.wrong: Wrong card. Outside, a puzzled pause.
lines.heap: Thousands of cards, all answered. You never found out what any of them said.
lines.reveal: Outside, a woman has been asking you questions. How are you. Do you like tea. What's the weather like. You answered perfectly.
lines.understand: To her, whoever is in the room speaks fluent Chinese. You don't know a single word.

end.text: So did the room understand Chinese? Did you? What does it mean to understand a language?

lines.stop_end: You stop answering. The cards pile up by the slot.
